locations.tagline: Cradle of the Renaissance & Brunelleschi's Dome
locations.quote: First one to the top wins! Try not to fall behind, brother.
locations.quoteContext: Ezio challenging Federico to a rooftop race across Florence
locations.spatialNote: Features Brunelleschi's Duomo and Palazzo Vecchio in compressed urban proportions.

locations.quote: Welcome to Villa Auditore. Here lies the legacy of your ancestor.
locations.quoteContext: Mario Auditore introducing Ezio to the sanctuary
locations.spatialNote: Ring of 14 watchtowers encircling Villa Auditore.

locations.tagline: Town of Fine Towers & Tuscan Stronghold
locations.quote: Towers reach for the heavens, but Templar greed roots them to the dirt.
locations.spatialNote: Medieval skyscrapers offering extreme vertical parkour vantage points.

locations.quote: I have the instruments, and more importantly, the courage to use them!
locations.spatialNote: Marshland wetlands combined with the imposing stone moat of Ravaldino.

locations.quote: If you want to move unseen in Venice, learn to swim in its shadows and canals.
locations.quoteContext: Rosa guiding Ezio through the Rialto district
locations.spatialNote: Recreates St. Mark's Campanile and the Grand Canal network.

locations.quote: I thought... I thought I was over this. But I cannot forgive.
locations.quoteContext: Ezio confrontation beneath St. Peter's Basilica
locations.spatialNote: Captures Old St. Peter's Basilica leading into an ancient Precursor Vault.
